title: PA TO THE CEO
company: Anderson Scott Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
PA TO THE CEO

Reading / Hybrid

Salary £32,000-£38,000

Permanent, Full Time

1 day per week in the Reading office 37.5 hours per week

The Opportunity

We are looking for an exceptionally organised, proactive and commercially aware PA to support the CEO of a growing business. This is not a traditional diary-management role.

You'll be the person who knows what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, who is responsible and what needs chasing. If you're naturally organised, commercially switched-on and confident enough to take ownership, challenge when necessary and keep things moving, this could be an excellent opportunity.

What You'll Be Doing

CEO Diary & Priorities
- Take ownership of the CEO's diary and ensure his time is used effectively.
- Manage competing demands and make sensible decisions around priorities.
- Build preparation and follow-up time into the diary.
- Identify clashes, pressure points and potential problems before they become issues.

Inbox & Action Management
- Support the CEO with a busy inbox, identifying priorities and ensuring important requests are dealt with.
- Maintain a clear list of outstanding actions, decisions and commitments.
- Follow up with senior colleagues and stakeholders to ensure deadlines are met.
- Confidently chase outstanding information and deliverables.
- Highlight anything overdue, blocked or requiring CEO intervention.

Meetings & Follow-Up
- Coordinate meetings and ensure the right people and information are in place.
- Prepare briefing information and relevant documents ahead of meetings.
- Track actions and follow up afterwards to ensure agreed outcomes happen.
- Help establish a consistent and professional approach to CEO meetings.

Reporting & Business Support
- Coordinate information and management reports from across the business.
- Ensure reporting deadlines are met and information is accurate.
- Maintain organised records and effective systems.
- Support the CEO with business and management administration.
- Identify ways to improve processes and reduce unnecessary administration.

About You

We're looking for someone who is sharp, diligent and naturally proactive.

You may currently be working as a:
- PA to a CEO, MD or senior executive
- Executive Assistant
- Senior Personal Assistant
- Office or Operations Manager with significant executive support experience

You'll be someone who:
- Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.
- Creates structure in a busy and changing environment.
- Follows things through and doesn't allow actions to disappear.
- Is confident communicating with senior people and chasing deadlines.
- Has excellent attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.
- Is discreet and trustworthy when dealing with confidential information.
- Has strong commercial awareness and understands the pressures of running a business.
- Remains calm and organised when priorities change.
- Has excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Is highly confident with Microsoft Office, email, calendars and business systems and able to learn new technology quickly.

The Personality Fit

This role will suit someone who is comfortable taking control.

You shouldn't need the CEO to tell you that something needs doing.

You'll be comfortable saying:

"You have a meeting at 2pm. You need to review this beforehand, this action is still outstanding and I've chased Sarah for an update."

You'll need the confidence to remind, challenge and push when appropriate, while having the judgement and emotional intelligence to know when to step in and when to step back.

If you enjoy being the person who brings order, structure and accountability to a busy environment, you'll thrive in this role.

What Success Looks Like

You'll know you're succeeding when:
- The CEO's diary is structured, realistic and under control.
- He is consistently prepared for important meetings.
- Actions and commitments are visible and followed through.
- Management reporting is received on time.
- Problems are identified before they reach the CEO.
- Operational detail is taken away from the CEO where appropriate.
- The CEO has more time and clarity to focus on strategic priorities and growing the business.

What's On Offer
- £32,000-£38,000 salary, depending on experience
- Hybrid working - 1 day per week in the Reading office
- Permanent, full-time position - 37.5 hours per week
- Close exposure to the CEO and senior management team
- A genuinely influential role within a growing business
- The opportunity to improve and shape how the CEO and management team operate
- A role where your organisation, judgement and initiative will have a visible impact

If you're an experienced PA or EA who wants genuine responsibility rather than simply managing a diary, we'd love to hear from you.

description: The successful applicant will support a wide range of pharmacy workflows including prescription administration, patient recall programmes and long-term condition clinics. This role brings the opportunity to assist in co-ordinating medication reviews, support audit programmes and manage patient recall systems. To thrive in this role, you will enjoy working in a fast-paced environment with multiple competing priorities. You will possess excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to communicate effectively with patients and healthcare professionals. You will be committed to delivering excellent patient care and able to work both independently and as part of a team. There may be on occasion, a requirement to carry out other tasks; this will be dependent upon factors such as workload and staffing levels. Prescription administration and medicines management Patient recall and service coordination Administration for medicines optimisation and clinical pharmacy support Audit, quality improvement and safety Training and team support Process repeat prescription requests received by phone, email, post, slips and the online access system, in accordance with practice protocol and standard operating procedures. Generate requests for non-repeat medications on behalf of patients, obtaining additional information where required. Manage and coordinate weekly prescription workflows to ensure timely processing of prescriptions. Ensure prescription requests are processed within agreed timescales. Act upon prescription compliance issues, liaising with the appropriate clinician. Have oversight of community pharmacy emergency supplies, escalating to the clinical pharmacy team when necessary. Build good working relationships with local Pharmacies to help enable our prescription service. Check emails regularly and deal with them appropriately. Patient recall and service coordination: Maintain medication review recall systems and invite patients for reviews in line with practice procedures. Manage medication review recall lists, including sending invitations, booking appointments and following up non-responders. Liaise with the Pharmacy Technician team regarding any monitoring requirements prior to medication reviews and arrange appointments or investigations as directed. Coordinate recalls for annual medication reviews, long-term condition reviews and pharmacist-led clinics. Book, rearrange and manage appointments for pharmacy-led services. Coordinate spirometry appointments and six-monthly heart failure recall programmes. Support the administration and management of the practice blood pressure monitor loan scheme. Maintain accurate records of recalls, appointments and patient communications. Add medication information and relevant coding to patient records in accordance with practice protocols and escalate any clinical concerns or treatment decisions to the Pharmacy Technician or Clinical Pharmacist team. Liaise with Pharmacy Technicians regarding monitoring requirements before medication reviews. Assist with the preparation and booking of Structured Medication Reviews. Process non-complex medication-related correspondence in accordance with practice protocols. Liaise with pharmacies on the supply of prescribed drugs, alert our clinicians of any supply issues and forward information on the recommended alternative. Support administration of long-term condition clinics and medicines optimisation programmes. Support delivery of medicines optimisation audits and quality improvement projects. Coordinate and support CQC, PQS, internal practice audits and high-risk drug monitoring. Undertake monthly medication ordering audits and reception medication request audits. Assist with data collection, reporting and maintenance of audit trackers. Support the administrative management of MHRA alerts, medication recalls and prescribing safety initiatives. Run searches and reports as requested and maintain accurate records of completed actions. Support the Clinical Pharmacy Team in reviewing and updating the practice prescribing related policies. Support the training of reception and administrative staff in prescription processes, prescribing workflows and pharmacy-related procedures. Contribute to improving pharmacy administrative processes and service delivery.
